models.title: Total simple interest on fixed original principal
models.summary: The text separates fixed original-principal interest in each period from interest earned on reinvested interest.

relationship.original_equation: Simple interest is interest rate times original principal each period; two periods on $100 at 5% produce $10 of simple interest.
relationship.locator: Section 5.1, printed p199 (PDF p2), simple interest
relationship.translation_notes: Derived definition from the CFA per-period simple-interest statement: sum N equal principal-only interest amounts. Pearson explicitly supplies I=Prt. N is a dimensionless financial count, not seconds. Currency times two dimensionless factors gives currency. Distinct from loan-payment-interest-portion because N-period cumulative simple interest never changes its original principal. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.
